capabilities: Calculate each Discovery product's cost and returned benefits from Budget-plugin transaction notes
Compare Discovery products against other South African banks, medical aids and insurers
Collect figures through a first-run question flow when no budget exists
Read Discovery Miles CSV statements saved anywhere in the vault
Label every figure with its source, as-at date and whether it is published
extras: Not yet in the community directory, so it must be installed manually from releases. Free, with no network requests, accounts or telemetry. Market prices are hardcoded with as-at dates and refreshed about every six months, with staleness warnings. Builds carry attestations and there is a test that fails the build if advice-like wording appears. data.json may travel with a synced or git vault and should be excluded from shared vaults.
problem: Discovery clients have no way to see, from their own records in Obsidian, whether what they pay Discovery comes back to them, or how their plans compare with other providers.

relations.evidence: It reads the bank transactions you already keep in Obsidian with the Budget plugin

summary: Finance calculator that judges whether each Discovery product is worth its cost, using your Budget-plugin transactions and the benefits you actually use.
